description: Land Title Settlement Department - Homagama, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520001
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, block numbers, cadastral maps, locations, and ownership details) in the Homagama area. The content focuses on land ownership, title registration, and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
